description: This file defines the EcuStimulator class, which provides functionality for stimulating and calibrating ECU parameters such as fuel and timing; includes methods for building tables, setting engine states, and collecting measurements.

classes.name: EcuStimulator
classes.description: Main class for stimulating ECU parameters, managing data visualization, and controlling engine calibration processes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EcuStimulator.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the main GUI panel containing controls and visualizations.

methods.name: buildTable
methods.description: Constructs a calibration table by scanning across RPM and engine load parameters, collecting measurement data.

methods.name: getInputs
methods.description: Returns the input configuration object for parameters like RPM steps and engine load range.

methods.name: createButton
methods.description: Creates a Swing button that initiates the calibration process when clicked.

methods.name: waitForMultipleResults
methods.description: Collects multiple dwell and advance measurements from engine time listeners.
